Unknown vs Atul Francis Zachariah Along With The on 10
November, 2023
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 1877 of 2022  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Ms. Devika Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey and Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By the instant C482 petition, the applicant is challenging the proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 11 of 2022, State vs. Atul Francis Zachariah along with the charge sheet dated 14.07.2022, for the offences punishable under sections 323, 504, 506, 342, 376 IPC pending in the court of District and Sessions Judge, Tehri Garhwal.

entities.text: court of District and Sessions Judge, Tehri Garhwal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The learned counsel for the applicant Ms. Devika Tiwari submits that the applicant is 26 years old and the victim - respondent no. 2 is 33 years old, and both of them being major entered into consensual live-in-relationship, and they are co-habitating together in Happy Home Stay, Rishikesh.

A first information report was lodged on 22.05.2022, bearing FIR No. 0034 of 2022 by respondent no. 2, implicating the applicant for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 504, 506, 342 and 376 IPC.

The learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the complainant was in live-in-relationship with the applicant since 09.04.2022, and after lodging of the FIR, the statement of the complainant was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., wherein she has stated that they became friend in short term and wanted to stay together, and, thereafter, the statement of the complainant was also recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she also admits that she was in live-in-relationship with the applicant and were staying together.
In her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she also stated that "I do not want to press the charges against the applicant and want to forgive him".
Apart from this, the learned counsel for the applicant submits that the medical report does not support the prosecution case.
Certain photographs have also been annexed.

5. After investigation, charge sheet was filed and the cognizance was taken on 19.07.2022, by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehri Garhwl, and, thereafter, the applicant was enlarged on bail Unknown vs Atul Francis Zachariah Along With The on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21481370/
1 on 28.07.2022, by this Court and while granting bail this Court took into consideration that they both were in live- in-relationship and were staying together.
6.

The learned counsel for the applicant submits that in view of the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., it is very clear that applicant and the complainant were in live-in- relationship and there was consensual relations between both of them, and, therefore, initiation of the proceedings against the applicant is nothing but an abuse of process of law.
7. This Court by order dated 20.10.2022 directed the State Counsel to get complete instructions in the matter.
Again this court by order dated 29.11.2022, granted further time to the State Government to get complete instructions.
8. Today Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder submits that he has not received any instruction and prays for and is granted four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.

9. Issue notice to respondent no. 2.
10.
Petitioner shall take steps to serve respondent no. 2 by registered post as well as by electronic mode within a period of seven working days.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Session Trial No. 11 of 2022, State vs. Atul Francis Zachariah for the offences punishable under sections 323, 504, 506, 342, 376 IPC pending in the court of District and Sessions Judge, Tehri Garhwal shall remain stayed.
